analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive days of wait-and-see. RSI rose from 38.6 to 44.4 but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram improved from -29.4315 to -9.9948 but is still negative. A Lower High pattern is in progress as the 5-day high is lower than the 20-day high, indicating weakness. Volume increased by 1.29x the 5-day average, adding conviction to the move, but lacks clear directional impetus.
